protocol.selection: Retrospective literature examples chosen from the frozen ChEMBL 37 panel by assay size and chemical-series relevance, not model performance. Not a preregistration or independent test set.
protocol.series_selection: Largest populated Murcko scaffold per assay; ties resolved by canonical scaffold SMILES. No potency-based series selection.
